newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up in sustained rally.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up in sustained rally.

text.p: Dhaka stocks gained 4.09 percent in a sustained rally on Monday as investors, encouraged by political stability, continued to make commitments, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index closed 4.09 per cent or 82.09 points up at 2,097.33 on a sharply higher turnover of 340.9 million taka. Of the 114 issues traded, 81 ended up, 31 closed down and two unchanged.

Bangladesh Tobacco Company gained 5.86 taka to 347.55, Beximco Pharma rose 4.42 to 272.28, Apex Foods was up 127.76 at 9,093.27. Brokers said the bull run continued mainly because of buying pressure by retail investors in a share-scarce market.
